name: Cool Runnings Catamaran Cruises
summary: Captain Robert Povey and Annika Povey own and run this catamaran company from Carlisle Wharf in Bridgetown. The daily lunch cruise stops to swim with sea turtles, snorkel a shallow shipwreck and visit a quiet bay, and a sunset dinner cruise sails twice a week. Transfers from your hotel or the cruise ship terminal are included, and the boats can be chartered privately.
standouts: Owned and run by Captain Robert Povey and Annika Povey
Custom-built catamarans that sail with a limited number of passengers
Transport to and from your hotel or the cruise ship terminal on lunch and sunset cruises
Three stops on the lunch cruise: sea turtles, a shipwreck and a beach in a secluded bay

contact.address: Carlisle House, Carlisle Wharf, Hincks Street, Bridgetown, Barbados, West Indies

trips.title: Daily Snorkel Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: A five hour daily sail to a secluded bay on the west coast, with three stops: swimming and snorkelling with sea turtles, a shallow shipwreck with tropical fish, and a beach. The crew provides snorkel gear and can teach beginners. A buffet lunch with wine and dessert is served on board at anchor.
highlights: Three stops: sea turtles, a shipwreck and a secluded beach
Buffet lunch with wine and dessert

trips.checkNotes: Advertises feeding schools of tropical fish at the shipwreck (fish, not turtles); left out of the summary. The cruise packages page (edited Nov 2023) omits the infant price; the lunch page (edited Oct 2025) was used. Reservations page is the operator's own form: card details held, nothing charged at booking, full payment at office check-in; last-minute cancellations are charged in full. Groups over 10 adults must contact the office. Departure point not stated on the trip page; the office is at Carlisle Wharf, Bridgetown.

trips.title: Sunset Snorkel Dinner Cruise
trips.summary: A four hour late afternoon sail on Wednesdays and Thursdays, with two stops: swimming and snorkelling with sea turtles, then a shipwreck with tropical fish. The boat then sails along the coast for the sunset, and a buffet dinner with wine and dessert is served as night falls.
highlights: Two snorkel stops: sea turtles and a shipwreck
